method.base_xy: ESTIMATE: observation.base_pose x/y are all zero in this session, so the commanded teleop.navigate_command velocity is rotated by the measured heading and integrated; heading itself is measured from the base quaternion

caveat: the estimate is the wrist at closure plus a fixed hand offset, so its scatter mixes real can placement with how the operator chose to grip; the data cannot separate the two

multi_attempt.note: the commanded hand closes exactly once per episode in all 97, so no re-grasp is possible; the measured finger joints are flat in 95/97 episodes (dummy hand feedback), so 'repeat approach' counts how many separate times the wrist entered the 3 cm x 2 cm box around its own grasp pose before closing
